take_homes: A model sounds equally confident whether or not it has a source, and asking it 'are you sure?' just gets another confident answer.
Don't pick a checking method on reputation. Run a few on your own material and let a scoreboard decide.
Chained steps compound errors, and a two-run test proves nothing.

misconception.why: A real documented case and the 'two runs is a demo' line made it sound unlike the earlier programmes. But this is a checking method, not proof the whole shift is real, so wait-and-see is not gone.

one_line: Less hype than I expected: you test the checks yourself and the tool states its own limits. I'm not sure it changes anything on my floor yet.
